- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5133-5146 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When total runs > 200 (i.e., page >= 3), the candidate pool merges only the last page and the page before it, and the first page (saved at :5120 as `_rgw_first_json`) is never merged back if `_rgw_page > 2`.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:5178-5180 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: The source graded this NIT (mapped here to low): operators cannot see whether the check was complete or covered only part of the queue; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1), and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined it because the server-side status and created-range filters prevent that path.
